name: n8n Telegram Supervisor
description: Telegram supervisor workflow inside n8n. Classifies inbound user intent and routes commands to the master orchestrator. High sensitivity because the same channel can drive any orchestrator action.

skills.name: Telegram Route
skills.description: Routes an inbound telegram message to the matching downstream workflow or action.

skills.name: Intent Classify
skills.description: Classifies the user intent of an inbound message using an LLM call.
